name: Oshawa Highway 2 Express–Finch
description: Limited-stop bus through Durham on Highway 2, continuing by Highway 401 to Scarborough Centre and Finch. It complemented the older local 94 and the station-based Highway 401 express 96.

timeline.event: Routes 95 and 96 were introduced as the Oshawa–Finch express network.
The original route 95 schedule documents the Highway 2 stopping pattern and Finch destination.
Last day of route 95 before the 92/96/98 reorganization.

gaps: No public lettered 95 branches have been established from the examined original timetable.
These are documented dated snapshots. Changes between snapshots, temporary diversions and every historical local stop have not all been recovered.
